ValidationRule.description: Other Term Reasons is not required when Reason For Term is not other.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.CaseValidations__c != true, $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $RecordType.Name = "Wage Claims", OR( ISPICKVAL( NSP_ReasonForTerm__c , 'Layoff'), ISPICKVAL( NSP_ReasonForTerm__c , 'Resignation with Notice'), ISPICKVAL( NSP_ReasonForTerm__c , 'Resignation without Notice'), ISPICKVAL( NSP_ReasonForTerm__c , 'Misconduct'), ISPICKVAL( NSP_ReasonForTerm__c , 'Unsatisfactory Job Performance'), ISPICKVAL( NSP_ReasonForTerm__c , '') ), NOT( ISBLANK( NSP_OtherReasonForTerm__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Other Reason for Term is not required
